  - Ingredients: Salmon fillet, olive oil, lemon, quinoa, spinach, cherry tomatoes, bell peppers, red onion, walnuts, pumpkin seeds, feta cheese, salt, pepper, balsamic vinegar.

- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe 2: Lentil and Vegetable Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
  - Ingredients: Brown rice, lentils, olive oil, onion, garlic, ginger, broccoli, carrots, red bell pepper, snap peas, soy sauce, sesame oil, crushed red pepper flakes, cashews, chia seeds, green onions.
  - Instructions: Cook brown rice and lentils, sauté onion, garlic, ginger, add vegetables, combine with lentils, mix sauce, stir in cashews and chia seeds, serve over brown rice.

  - Instructions: Marinate chicken, grill, combine salad ingredients, drizzle with dressing, serve with chicken and pita.

- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] Recipe 4: Spinach and Feta Stuffed Chicken Breast with Roasted Vegetables and Quinoa
  - Ingredients: Chicken breast, fresh spinach, feta cheese, olive oil, salt, pepper, garlic powder, quinoa, assorted vegetables, fresh parsley.
